blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Aaj hum Unit 2, Further Differentiation, shuru kar rahe hain. Class XI mein aap ne differentiation ki buniyad (foundation) rakhi thi: derivative ki definition, aur sum, difference, product aur quotient rules. Ab is unit mein hum us buniyad par poori imarat khari karenge. Pehle sabaq, 2.1, mein hum woh sab dobara taaza karenge jo aage har jagah kaam aayega. Is ko halka mat lijiye: aage ke har sawal mein yahi rules baar baar lagenge, bilkul jaise ghar ki har deewar mein wohi eenten lagti hain.

Kitab ka taaruf (introduction) yeh kehta hai: differentiation calculus ka ek buniyadi concept hai jo Newton aur Leibniz ne diya. Is ki madad se hum dekhte hain ke koi miqdar (quantity) kaise badalti hai. Pichli class mein humne differentiation ki definition aur sum, difference, product, quotient rules parhe, aur un se polynomials aur rational functions ke derivatives nikale. Ab hum trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, exponential aur logarithmic functions ke derivatives nikalna seekhenge. Phir differentiation ko use kar ke dekhenge ke function kahan barh raha hai (increasing) aur kahan ghat raha hai (decreasing), aur curves par kisi khaas point par tangent aur normal ki equations banayenge. Algebraic, implicit, parametric aur transcendental functions ke higher-order derivatives bhi parhenge. Linear approximation aur differentials se function ki values aur tabdeeliyon ka andaza lagayenge, aur asal zindagi ki misalon (jaise geometric shapes ke volume) mein relative aur percentage error nikalenge. Aakhir mein critical points ki madad se local aur global extrema (sab se bari aur sab se chhoti values) dhoondenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is unit ko parhne ka tareeqa: is ki taqreeban har cheez 2.1 ke chand rules par khari hai. Aage barhne se pehle khud ko test kar lijiye ke kya aap har rule baghair dekhe laga sakte hain.
Unit ki tarteeb aise samajhiye: pehle naye derivatives seekhenge (trigonometric 2.2 mein, chain rule 2.3 mein, inverse trigonometric 2.4 mein, exponential 2.5 mein, logarithmic 2.6 mein). Phir derivative ke istemal (applications) aayenge: tangent aur normal, higher derivatives, increasing aur decreasing functions, maxima aur minima, aur approximation. Yani pehle auzaar (tools) banayenge, phir un se kaam lenge.

Definition: function \(y = f(x)\) ke derivative ko \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ya \(f'(x)\) se likhte hain, aur is ki definition yeh hai:
\[f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0}\dfrac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}\]
agar yeh limit mojood (exist) ho, ya doosri shakal mein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{\delta y}{\delta x}\]
agar yeh limit mojood ho.
Kitab kehti hai: derivative kisi point par function ki instantaneous rate of change (usi lamhe ki tabdeeli ki raftaar) batata hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is definition ko teen hisson mein parhiye. Pehla hissa: \(f(x+h) - f(x)\). Yeh batata hai ke jab \(x\) mein thori si tabdeeli \(h\) hoti hai to function kitna badalta hai. Doosra hissa: is ko \(h\) se divide karna. Is se average rate of change milti hai, jo do points \((x, f(x))\) aur \((x+h, f(x+h))\) ko milane wali secant line (do points se guzarne wali seedhi line) ka slope hai. Teesra hissa: \(h \to 0\). Jab doosra point pehle point ke bilkul qareeb aa jata hai to secant line tangent line ban jati hai, aur average rate instantaneous rate ban jati hai.
Ek misaal: motorway par aap ne do ghante mein 200 km tay kiye to average speed 100 km/h hai. Lekin speedometer jo dikhata hai woh usi lamhe ki speed hai. Derivative yahi speedometer wali speed hai.
Doosri shakal mein bhi yahi baat hai: \(\delta x\) ka matlab hai \(x\) mein chhoti si tabdeeli, aur \(\delta y\) us se \(y\) mein aane wali tabdeeli. Dhyan dein: \(\delta x\) ek hi symbol hai, yeh \(\delta\) guna \(x\) nahin.
Aur yaad rakhiye: shuru mein hi \(h = 0\) nahin rakh sakte, warna \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai jis ka koi matlab nahin. Pehle simplify karte hain, phir \(h\) cancel karte hain (yeh jaiz hai kyun ke \(h\) zero ke qareeb ja raha hai magar zero nahin hai), aur aakhir mein limit lete hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
First principles (yani seedha definition se) \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ka derivative nikalte hain.
Pehle function ki tabdeeli nikalein:
\[f(x+h) - f(x) = (x+h)^{2} - x^{2}\]
\[= 2xh + h^{2}\]
Ab \(h\) se divide karein (har term mein \(h\) hai, is liye cancel ho jata hai):
\[\dfrac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h} = 2x + h\]
Ab limit lein, \(h\) ki jagah 0:
\[f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0}(2x + h) = 2x\]
Dekha? Neeche wala power rule bhi yahi jawab deta hai. Power rule asal mein isi definition ka shortcut hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Definition se \(f(x) = 3x\) ka derivative nikaliye. Kya jawab 3 aata hai? Kyun? (Ishara: \(f(x+h) - f(x) = 3h\).) Seedhi line ka slope har jagah ek jaisa hota hai, is liye derivative constant hai.

blocks.title: Recall!
blocks.text:
Power Rule: \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = n\,x^{n-1}\), jahan \(n \in \mathbb{R}\) (koi bhi real number).
Constant Rule: \(\frac{d}{dx}(c) = 0\), har constant \(c \in \mathbb{R}\) ke liye.
Neeche wale rules mein \(u = u(x)\) aur \(v = v(x)\) differentiable functions hain aur \(c\) koi bhi constant hai.
Constant Multiple Rule: \(\frac{d}{dx}(cu) = c\frac{du}{dx} = cu'\).
Sum and Difference Rule: \(\frac{d}{dx}(u \pm v) = \frac{du}{dx} \pm \frac{dv}{dx} = u' \pm v'\)
Product Rule: do functions ke product (zarb) ka derivative nikalne ke liye.
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(uv) = u'v + uv'\]
Quotient Rule: do functions ki division (taqseem) ka derivative nikalne ke liye.
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\dfrac{u}{v}\right) = \dfrac{u'v - uv'}{v^{2}}\]
jahan domain ke har \(x\) ke liye \(v(x) \ne 0\) ho.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kaun sa rule kab lagana hai? Yeh sab se zaroori sawal hai, kyun ke rule yaad hona kaafi nahin, sahi jagah lagana aana chahiye:
1. Agar \(x\) ki sirf ek power ho, chahe root ho ya reciprocal, to power rule. Root ko pehle power bana lein: \(\sqrt{x} = x^{1/2}\), is liye \(\frac{d}{dx}\sqrt{x} = \frac{1}{2}x^{-1/2} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\).
2. Function ke aage koi number ho to constant multiple rule: number apni jagah rehta hai, sirf function ka derivative lete hain.
3. Terms + ya - se jure hon to sum and difference rule: har term ka alag derivative lo aur jor do.
4. Do functions aapas mein zarb hon to product rule. 5. Ek function doosre se divide ho to quotient rule.
Dhyan dein: quotient rule mein tarteeb bohat zaroori hai. Numerator mein pehle upar wale function ka derivative aata hai: u'v - uv'. Agar ulta likh diya (uv' - u'v) to jawab ka sign ulat jayega.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(a) \(\frac{d}{dx}(3x^{4} - 5x^{2} + 7) = 12x^{3} - 10x\). Yahan power rule, constant multiple rule, sum rule aur constant rule chaaron ek saath lage. 7 ka derivative zero hai kyun ke constant badalta hi nahin.
(b) Product rule: \(y = (x^{2} + 1)(x^{3} - 2x)\). Pehle \(u = x^{2} + 1\) aur \(v = x^{3} - 2x\) pehchanein, phir \(u' = 2x\), \(v' = 3x^{2} - 2\).
\[y' = 2x(x^{3} - 2x) + (x^{2} + 1)(3x^{2} - 2)\]
\[= 5x^{4} - 3x^{2} - 2\]
Tasdeeq ke liye pehle zarb kar ke dekh lein: y = x^5 - x^3 - 2x, jis ka derivative bhi wohi aata hai.
(c) Quotient rule: \(y = \frac{2x + 1}{x - 3}\), \(x \ne 3\). Yahan \(u = 2x + 1\), \(v = x - 3\), \(u' = 2\), \(v' = 1\).
\[y' = \dfrac{2(x - 3) - (2x + 1)(1)}{(x - 3)^{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{-7}{(x - 3)^{2}}\]
Numerator mein 2x - 6 - 2x - 1 = -7 bacha. Bracket ke aage minus ho to andar ke dono sign badalna mat bhooliye.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}\): derivative average rate of change ki limit hai.
2. Derivative kisi point par instantaneous rate of change hai, yani us point par tangent ka slope.
3. \(\frac{dy}{dx}\), \(f'(x)\) aur \(y'\) ek hi derivative ke mukhtalif naam hain.
4. Chhe rules (power, constant, constant multiple, sum/difference, product, quotient) is unit ke har agle section mein istemal honge, is liye inhein pakka kar lijiye.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Simplify karne se pehle hi \(h = 0\) rakh dena: \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai aur sawal wahin ruk jata hai.
2. \((uv)' = u'v'\) likh dena: product ka derivative derivatives ka product nahin hota.
3. Quotient rule mein tarteeb ulat dena (\(uv' - u'v\)): is se jawab ka sign ulat jata hai.
4. Quotient rule mein yeh shart bhool jana ke \(v(x) \ne 0\) ho.
5. Bracket se pehle minus ho to andar ke saare signs badalna bhool jana.
